edit.description: span reader reports a span its comment line leaves open
fixture detector first, then the repo pin's refusal
rewrap so the rules-page citation sits on one line

summary: Report a backticked span its comment line leaves open, so a wrap cannot silently un-judge a path citation; repair the two sites the wrap broke

per.section: Narration is the ladder's bottom rung

acceptance: A span left open at its comment line's end is reported; the repo pin reds on one carrying a `/`, and both sites cite the page on one line.
tests: the citation scan reports a backticked span its comment line leaves open
the repo citation pin refuses a path citation broken across a comment line
notes: The reader matches `/`([^`\n]+)`/g`, so a span crossing a line is not read at all. src/paths.ts:274 and src/friction.ts:133 wrap `.claude/rules/` + `engineering.md`; both escape the pin, and renaming the page leaves them standing. Markdown joins a wrapped span with a space, so the wrap breaks the path — the slash is the claim (`isPathSubject`). ~28 other wrapped spans are commands, none carrying a `/`. Keep the file shape: detector in the fixture before the repo absence.
